title: MSFS 2024 Air Races Launch Night: Real Flight Physics or Pure Arcade? (Viewer Open Lobbies)
description:
The National Championship Air Races have officially returned in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024! Tonight at 20:00 CET, we are putting all 5 racing classes to the test across the brand-new Roswell course and 1v1 STOL Drag tracks. 

Is Asobo’s updated wear-and-tear flight modeling, manifold pressure limits, and wake turbulence the real deal—or did the physics get dumbed down? We are flying wide-open throttle to find out, stress-testing engine limits, and opening live multiplayer lobbies so YOU can race against the stream!

🏁 RACE LIVE AGAINST THE STREAM (HOW TO JOIN):
Want to jump into our open multiplayer heats tonight? We coordinate all lobby passcodes and server regions through our Discord server to keep downtime between heats to zero!
1. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/J3tZyhceUM
2. Grab the @AirRacer role in #announcements
3. Lobby passcodes and flight assignments drop in #pylon-staging 10 minutes before each green flag!

⏱️ STREAM RUN OF SHOW:
00:00 - Pre-Flight Briefing & Server Grid Setup
10:00 - Class 1: Unlimited Warbirds (P-51D Mustang) | Engine Thermal & Manifold Test
35:00 - Class 2: Jet Class (L-39 Albatros) | High-G Energy Management at Roswell
1:00:00 - Community Open Lobby Heat 1 (Viewer Grid)
1:25:00 - Class 3 & 4: T-6 Texan & Pitts Special S1-S | Pylon Formation & Wake Turbulence
1:50:00 - Community Open Lobby Heat 2 (Viewer Grid)
2:15:00 - Class 5: 1v1 STOL Drag Battles (CubCrafters XCub) | Flap Dumps & Brake Tests
2:45:00 - Final Leaderboard & the verdict: real sim or arcade?

✈️ SIM RIG & FLIGHT CONTROLS:
• Simulator: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
• Peripherals: MOZA AB6 Force Feedback Base
• PC Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X3D | NVIDIA RTX 4090 24GB | 64GB DDR5 RAM
